# Dubai Dune Tours

> Dubai's premier direct-operator desert safari company. Certified in-house fleet of Toyota Land Cruisers, licensed safari drivers, and private desert camps in the high red dunes of Lehbab. Book directly with zero middleman markup, pay on arrival with zero deposit, and free 24-hour cancellation.

## Key Facts & Operator Highlights
- **Direct Operator Guarantee**: No 25-35% reseller commissions (Viator, GetYourGuide). Deal directly with the vehicle fleet & camp operators.
- **Payment Policy**: Pay on the day of the tour in cash (AED, USD, EUR, GBP) or card. Zero advance deposit required.
- **Cancellation**: 100% Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup.
- **Pickup & Drop-off**: Free hotel, residence, and Airbnb transfers across Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman.
- **Location**: Lehbab High Red Dunes (Big Red), Dubai, UAE.
- **Licensing**: Fully licensed by Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) since 2010.
- **Customer Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 rating with 401+ verified Google & TripAdvisor reviews. Over 25,000 guests hosted.
- **Fast WhatsApp Booking**: Reply within 3 minutes in English, Arabic, Russian, and French. Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 601 5834.

## Safari Packages & Pricing

### Evening Desert Safaris
- [Evening Standard Safari (AED 79/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/standard): Classic desert evening with 35-min red dune bashing, sunset photo stop, camel ride, sandboarding, 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet (veg/non-veg), Tanoura show, belly dance, and fire show.
- [Evening Premium Safari (AED 119/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/premium): Most popular tier. Includes all standard features PLUS 15-minute quad bike adventure, reserved VIP table with table service, live grill stations, and hunting falcon photo encounter. Max 6 guests per 4x4.
- [Evening VIP Safari (AED 299/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/evening-safari/vip): Exclusive luxury tier. Private Land Cruiser, dedicated air-conditioned VIP Majlis tent with personal butler, 5-course gourmet table-service dinner, hands-on master falconry session, and premium shisha lounge.

### Morning, Sunrise & Self-Drive Tours
- [Sunrise Desert Safari (AED 349/vehicle)](https://dubaidunetours.com/morning-safari): Private Land Cruiser at dawn (04:30 AM pickup). Untouched red dunes, sunrise dune bashing, hot Arabic breakfast picnic & Gahwa coffee, sandboarding, and return by 09:30 AM before Dubai heat.
- [Morning Dune Bash & Sandboard (AED 130/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/morning-safari): 4-hour morning adventure (08:00 AM – 12:00 PM) featuring high-adrenaline dune bashing, sandboarding, camel photo stop, and free hotel pickup.
- [Self-Drive Desert Convoy (AED 35/person)](https://dubaidunetours.com/self-drive): Drive your own 4x4 or SUV following certified guide convoy with satellite radio communication. Includes full camp entry, live shows, and BBQ dinner.

### VIP & Ultra-Luxury Private Setups
- [VIP Traditional Arabic Safari (AED 999 / 2 adults)](https://dubaidunetours.com/vip-traditional-arabic): Private 4x4, personal falcon trainer session, private air-conditioned Majlis tent, 5-course table service Arabic feast under the stars, henna art & shisha.
- [Private Desert Camp Setup (AED 2,299 / group up to 8 guests)](https://dubaidunetours.com/private-desert-setup): 100% private secluded desert camp on an isolated red dune with personal chef, romantic fairy light canopy, telescope for stargazing, and private sound system. Zero other tourists. Ideal for proposals, anniversaries, and VIP events.
